notes.title: NEW FUTURE DELUXE UPDATE TEASER! - 📢
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="VOao07RPPtA;full"][/previewyoutube]
In this teaser, we show you a little bit of the game's new look, locations, lighting, and evolution in the designs.

We promised to change everything, be it the gameplay, the visuals, and include a new storyline. We've listened to many requests and criticism. Now, the minigames will no longer be mandatory and you can follow a new story, with different events and achievements to unlock.


The update contains more secrets and places to explore. If you haven't purchased the game yet, add it to your wishlist and wait for the next update!!
